verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe a 'living knowledge graph of facts on top of other facts' with graph traversal search (`include: { relatedMemories: true }`) enabling entity-centric, multi-hop questions like 'where does Alex work?' built from linked facts (e.g. Alex + Stripe). This is a first-party documented feature distinct from plain vector search, retrievable via a dedicated 'memory graph traversal' mode alongside document search and profiles. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of multi-hop query accuracy and no benchmark evidence specifically testing entity-relationship reasoning depth.
